The '''Overload Dispersal Collar''' was a weapon component used on [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] such as the [[Taim & Bak/Legends|Taim & Bak's]] [[KX9 laser cannon/Legends|KX9 laser cannons]]. Located halfway along the [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]], the Overload Dispersal Collar was connected to the weapon's [[cooling sleeve]].<ref name="EGWT" />
